hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';if(f)process.stdout.write(f);}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ]; then git add -- "$f" 2>/dev/null; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m "Auto-commit: update $(basename "$f")" --quiet && git push origin HEAD --quiet; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
